mintAuthority.summary: AUDF issuer-native minting is controlled by the Admin Safe at 0x6929fd915b0755efdc255ea841b68a263a362c5a. Current Ethereum, Polygon, and Base reads show a 2-of-5 Safe, while the separate Avalanche Safe at the same address is 2-of-3. Current Polygon and Base reads do not give the formerly recorded operational EOA MINT_ROLE. The August Redbelly observation remains historical: that Safe held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE with MINT_ROLE unassigned. The Ethereum LayerZero OFT adapter is bridge machinery assessed only under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: AUDF Admin Safe (DEFAULT_ADMIN + MINT_ROLE, multichain)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25573497, Safe reads returned version 1.3.0, the listed five owners, threshold 2, and no enabled modules; prior reviewed Safe state records a zero guard. Confirmed DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MINT_ROLE on Ethereum, Polygon, and Base via role logs; on Avalanche confirmed DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MINT_ROLE via hasRole; on Redbelly the Safe holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE while MINT_ROLE is currently unassigned. ProxyAdmin on Ethereum (0x2dcafce3b4fc7aba1b822637b12d6156fc85edd9) is owned by this Safe, and the shared implementation/proxy-admin pattern is re-confirmed on Ethereum, Polygon, and Avalanche at the current review blocks. The Ethereum OFT adapter is not part of this native control.

controls.label: Former AUDF Polygon/Base operational EOA (no current MINT_ROLE)
controls.evidence: Current hasRole reads at Polygon block 94755498 and Base block 52024317 return false for this EOA and MINT_ROLE, whose contract getter returns 0x154c00819833dac601ee5ddded6fda79d9d8b506b911b3dbd54cdb95fe6c3686. The old evidence identified role 0x22435ed... as MINT_ROLE; the verified implementation and current getter identify that hash as BLACKLIST_ROLE. Prior RoleGranted observations are historical and do not establish a current native mint role.

controls.label: AUDF Avalanche Admin Safe (DEFAULT_ADMIN + MINT_ROLE)
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 96511532, the deployed Safe at 0x6929fd915b0755efdc255ea841b68a263a362c5a has three owners and threshold 2. Its owner set differs from the five-owner Ethereum, Polygon, and Base Safe at the same address. The token MINT_ROLE is held by this Safe, and ProxyAdmin owner() returns this Safe.

sources.label: AUDF Redbelly deployment explorer linked by Forte (identity only; historical roles not refreshed)

review.evidence: On 2026-10-01, pinned reads reconfirmed the AUDF implementation and ProxyAdmin on Ethereum, Polygon, Base, and Avalanche. ProxyAdmin owner() names the Admin Safe. The Ethereum, Polygon, and Base Safe has five owners and threshold 2; Avalanche has three owners and threshold 2 and is now represented separately. The previous operational EOA mint claim confused BLACKLIST_ROLE hash 0x22435ed... with MINT_ROLE hash 0x154c008...; current MINT_ROLE reads on Polygon and Base return false for that EOA. Redbelly control facts retain their prior August scope because its endpoint was not recovered in this session. Direct Safe issuance and mutable ProxyAdmin powers remain adverse controls; no economic-cap or supervision tier is upgraded.
